div.l: He was a lord ful fat and in gode poynt
His yen stepe and rollyng in his hede
That semed as a forneys of lede
His botys souple his hors in grete estate
Now certeynly he was a feyre prelate
He nas nat pale as forpyned gost
A fat swan loued he best of eny rost
His palfray was as broun as is a bery /
A frere ther was a wantan and a mery ¶ A Frere
A lymyter a ful solempne man̄
In al þe orders fowre is non that can̄
So mochel of daliaunce and feir͗e langage
He hed made ful mony a maryage maryage
Of yonge wymmēn at his owne cost
Vnto his ordre he was a noble post
Ful welbeloued and famylier was he
With frankelens oueral in his contre
And with worthi wemen̄ of þe town̄e
For he had power of confessioıı̄une
And seide hym selfe more than a Curat
For of his ordre he was licenciat
Full swetly harde he confessioıı̄un
And plesant was his absolucoıı̄un
He was an esy man̄ to yeuen penaunce
Ther as he wist to have a gode pitaunce
For vnto apore ordre forto yeve
Is signe that a man̄ is well yshryve
For yf he yafe he durst make avaunt
He wist that a man was repentaunt
For many a man̄ so hard is of his herte
He may nought wepe al þough hym sore smerte
Therfore in stede of wepyng and preyers
Men̄ mote yeve seluer to the pore frerys
His tepet was aye forsed ful of knyues
And pynnes for to yeven̄ feyre wyues
And certeȳnly he had a mery note
Wel couth he synge ⁊and pleyen̄ on̄ a rote
Of yeddynges he bare vtterly þe prys
His nek white was as þe flour͗e delys
Therto he stronge was as A Champyoıı̄un
